messages:
Kevin: quick ping — PR #30999 is ready for cross-team sign-off. touches routing fallback + eviction header. need runtime + infra + sec eyes before canary.
Maya: on it, Kevin. can you paste the brief of the change and any risk notes?
Kevin: summary: split fallback policy into 2 tiers, add new header `x-evict-reason` and small runtime hook to prefer cheaper model variants if capacity low. risk: potential header mismatch for old clients; fallback ordering change.
Jon: infra: looking at the yaml change now. main concern is we add a new k8s flag to rollout; need upgrade plan for older nodepools. please include migration step in the PR description.
Kevin: noted — added migration steps and a one-line rollout plan to the PR. also added a feature flag: `enable_eviction_header` default off for canary.
Sam: security quick note: header content needs validation and we should avoid logging raw reasons. can you add a sanitizer and a config toggle for redaction?
Kevin: will add sanitizer and redact-by-default. also adding unit tests for header parsing.
Maya: runtime: main ask is an explicit compatibility test for KV cache key changes. otherwise I can own canary monitoring.
Kevin: thanks — added test + healthcheck metric `eviction.header.mismatch` and a Prometheus dashboard panel.
OpsBot: deploy-bot attached diff link: https://git.rex/redwood/pr/30999 -> CI: ✅ unit, 🚫 e2e flaky on network emulation
Maya: e2e flaky looks unrelated, rerunning. canary window needed: tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT. who can own rollback?
Jon: I can own rollback + nodepool coord.
Sam: I can sign off on security after sanitizer is in place.
Maya: runtime will monitor latency and kv-miss rate for first 30 min.
Kevin: great. tagging reviewers in PR: @Maya (runtime), @Jon (infra), @Sam (security). requesting final thumbs by EOD so we can grab tomorrow's canary slot. :thumbsup:
Maya: 👍 will finish review in the next hour.
Jon: 👍 will approve if infra changes stay as-is.
Sam: leaving a small comment on the sanitizer impl, then 👍 once fixed.
Kevin: thanks all — will merge to canary after approvals and post canary playbook in the thread.
Maya: small follow-up: please include a quick rollback command snippet in PR description, e.g.:
```
kubectl annotate deployment runtime rollout=rollback --overwrite
```
Kevin: added. good catch.
Sam: noted a low-risk suggestion to mask the header at ingress — filing a tiny follow-up PR after canary.
Kevin: perfect. closing loop here — will post canary status as comments. appreciate the quick sync :rocket:
